description: Tribal Trouble Buffed: this fork's new content, layered on Resurrected, whose numbers it keeps. New buildings: the Chicken Coop / Henhouse and the Totem / Runestone (milestone M5, PLAN.md section 4.5). New gear from the Armory: the Shield (Bark-Shield Bearer / Round-Shield Carl) and the Torch (Firebrand / Torchbearer), which fight hand to hand; a torch sets buildings on fire (milestone M6, PLAN.md section 4.4, docs/design/gear.md). More buildings: the Trading Post / Market, where peons trade 3 of one resource for 1 of another (docs/design/market.md), and Palisade segments and Gates, walls that block movement and gates that let their own side through (docs/design/palisade.md; milestone M7). Late buildings: the Great Tower, which three throwers man at once (docs/design/great-tower.md), and the Spirit Lodge / Mead Hall, which shelters units, speeds the spells of chieftains nearby and trains the Champion (Headhunter / Berserker), capped at five (docs/design/lodge-and-champion.md; milestone M8). Support gear: the Drum / Horn (Drummer / Hornblower), which never attacks but lifts the hit chance and speed of its side nearby and is everyone's first target, and the Net (Chicken Catcher / Fowler), which catches a chicken in one stroke and lays snares that stun the first enemy on them (docs/design/drum-and-net.md; milestone M9). Wild animals: beach crabs, monkeys that steal a passing carrier's load (tropical islands), and boars (tropical) or wolves (northern) that attack a lone peon in deep forest (docs/design/fauna.md; milestone M9). Their numbers are repeated here so Buffed's balance reads in one file. Field reference: docs/rulesets.md.
